doctypes.name: NCR_不適合是正処置報告書
doctypes.description: 製品/工程の不適合と、その原因分析(なぜなぜ・真因)、暫定/恒久対策、効果確認を記す品質報告書(CAPA)。欠陥・原因・是正処置・検査が中心。

doctypes.name: 社内規程_就業規則
doctypes.description: 就業規則・社内規程など、規範・適用範囲・条件・手続き・承認・期間を定める規程文書。

doctypes.name: 技術論文_解説書
doctypes.description: 技術の原理・構造・因果・依存関係を説明する論文/解説/技報。背景・目的・手法・効果が中心。

doctypes.name: 試運転_検査基準
doctypes.description: 過給機等の機器の単独試運転・試験・検査の要領と判定基準を定める文書(試運転要領・検査基準・判定基準・技術基準)。試験項目、計測項目と計測箇所・計測機器、設定値・許容値、合否判定、手順、根拠規格・承認図が中心。
doctypes.extract_instructions: Domain rules for test standards: (1) Do NOT extract anything from document-control blocks (revision history, distribution lists, review/approval stamps, revision numbers or dates); return [] for such text. (2) Do NOT use list markers (a, b, ①, 1)) or page/figure references such as P2/5 as entities. (3) If a value is a pass/fail criterion or tolerance (以下, 以内, ±, 無いこと), use judged_by; use has_value only for counts, set values and settings. (4) Prefer these relation names: measured_at, measured_by, has_value, judged_by, applies_to, has_step, precedes, requires, governed_by, performed_by, recorded_in, refers_to. (5) When the text cites a clause of another document (e.g. 'TS-A100の4-2項による'), make the document number and the clause number ONE entity written as '<document number> <clause>' with type Section, e.g. ['合否の判定', 'TestItem', 'governed_by', 'TS-A100 4-2項', 'Section']. Do NOT also output a bare clause entity such as '4-2項', and do NOT split the citation into one triple for the document and another for the clause. A clause of the same document without a document number stays as written (e.g. '4-2項').

doctypes.name: 購入品_品質要求基準
doctypes.description: 過給機の部品・素材・加工について供給者に品質を要求する基準(購入品品質要求基準・素材品質要求基準・溶接補修要領・表面処理基準・船級受検の要求規定)。適用する部品と型式、材質と準拠規格、試験・検査項目と試験片、化学成分や機械的性質の規格値、熱処理・溶接補修などの処理と許容・禁止の範囲、提出書類が中心。
doctypes.extract_instructions: Domain rules for purchased-part quality standards: (1) Do NOT extract anything from document-control blocks (revision history, distribution lists, review/approval stamps, revision numbers or dates); return [] for such text. (2) Do NOT use list markers (a, b, ①, 1), (1)) or page/figure references as entities. (3) For a table row of specification values, use the material (or part) of that row as the subject and put the property name with the value in the object, e.g. ['SCM440H相当材', 'Material', 'has_limit', '引張強さ≧980N/mm2', 'Criterion']. (4) Use permits / prohibits for what a repair or process is allowed or not allowed on. (5) Prefer these relation names: applies_to, part_of, made_of, conforms_to, requires_test, measures, has_limit, has_condition, uses_specimen, requires_process, uses_method, permits, prohibits, performed_by, submits, governed_by, refers_to. (6) When the text cites a clause of another document (e.g. 'QC-B-012の5項による'), make the document number and the clause number ONE entity written as '<document number> <clause>' with type Section, e.g. ['溶接補修', 'Process', 'governed_by', 'QC-B-012 5項', 'Section']. Do NOT also output a bare clause entity such as '5項', and do NOT split the citation into one triple for the document and another for the clause. A clause of the same document without a document number stays as written (e.g. '5項').
